about.title: A Home Away From Home
about.p: Debre Mihret Kidus Gebriel serves the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo community in Christchurch and the wider Canterbury region. We gather for worship, fellowship, and to preserve our faith and heritage in Aotearoa New Zealand.

cta.title: Join Our Community
cta.p: Whether you are new to Christchurch or looking for a spiritual home, you are welcome here. Come worship with us.
